newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK fire death toll up to 16, police to charge five.
newsitem.headline: HK fire death toll up to 16, police to charge five.

text.p: The death toll from a fire in a Hong Kong karaoke bar rose to 16 on Monday after another victim died, police said.
The 24-year-old man died in hospital on Monday afternoon, police said in a statement.
The statement said five suspects would be charged with murder in connection with the fire at the Top One karaoke night club early on Saturday in Hong Kong's Tsimshatsui district.
It said the three men and two women, aged between 17 and 27, would appear in court on Tuesday.
A sixth man, aged 28, was still being questioned, the statement said. The names of those arrested were not given.

The blaze is believed to have been caused by a petrol bomb and linked to a turf war between rival "triad" crime gangs fighting over protection rackets. The five to be charged on Tuesday are suspected members of the Sun Yee On triad group.
Two victims of the fire remained in hospital on Monday, one in critical condition, a government spokeswoman said.
Autopsies on those killed in the fire showed they died of smoke inhalation although the actual cause of death has yet to be confirmed by further tests, police said.
